1.text: I told my wife she should embrace her mistakes. She gave me a hug.

2.text: What did the big flower say to the little flower? "Hi, bud!"

3.text: I went to buy some camouflage wear, but I couldn't find any.

4.text: What did the grape say when it got stepped on? Nothing, it just let out a little wine.

5.text: I used to have a job at a calendar factory, but I got fired because I took a couple of days off.

6.text: Did you hear about the restaurant on the moon? Great food, no atmosphere!

7.text: What did one wall say to the other wall? I'll meet you at the corner!

8.text: What did one hat say to the other hat? You stay here, I'll go on ahead!

9.text: Did you hear about the guy who got hit in the head with a can of soda? He was lucky it was a soft drink.

10.text: I'm writing a book about glue, but I'm stuck on the first chapter.

11.text: Stop looking for the perfect match; use a lighter.

12.text: Did you hear the rumor about butter? Well, I'm not going to go spreading it!

13.text: If two vegetarians get in an argument, is it still called beef?

14.text: If a vegan crossfit fan is using Claude to write Rust, which thing do they tell you first?

15.text: I have a clean conscience - it's never been used.

16.text: I love telling Dad jokes. Sometimes, he even laughs.
